name: Ngó Sen GNOME fixes
description: On GNOME 50.0 to 50.3 delivers keys that an input method forwards to the app, which mutter drops (mutter#4853). Also tells Ngó Sen which app has focus: fcitx5 before 5.1.22 names every app on GNOME after GNOME Shell, and Ngó Sen otherwise learns the app from xdg-desktop-portal-gnome, which does not name apps without a .desktop file.
